values: 飞到空中对敌人进行连续射击。
Aliceth flies into the air and fires arrows at an enemy.
亚莉克希飞到空中，对一名敌人快速地发射6波箭雨连击。每波箭雨附带3支箭且每箭造成100% + 10% ATK伤害，并额外附带敌人已损生命值5%的伤害，额外附带伤害至多不超过自身50% ATK。在空中时，亚莉克希处于无敌状态。

Aliceth flies into the air and fires 6 volleys of 3 arrows in rapid succession at an enemy. Each arrow deals 100% + 10% ATK damage, plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 50% ATK. Aliceth remains invincible while airborne.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 105% + 10% ATK.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 110% + 10% ATK.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 115% + 10% ATK.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 120% + 10% ATK.
被动地，为友军赋予“光翼”权能，使其在造成若干次伤害后额外发射飞羽；主动释放时，造成高额伤害并击退击晕敌人。

Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, allowing them to unleash a feather strike after dealing damage a set number of times.
Active. Aliceth strikes an enemy for heavy damage, knocking them back and stunning them.

被动地，亚莉克希将“光翼”权能赋予一名友军，使其在对敌人造成3次远程伤害时发射1枚飞羽，对敌人造成120% + 20% ATK伤害，每0.5秒至多触发一次。若拥有“光翼”权能的友军为远程角色还会额外提升5格普通攻击的攻击距离。亚莉克希优先选择同排最近的友军赋予权能，且这名友军会在被击败后失去权能。
主动释放时，亚莉克希蓄力劲射，对一名敌人造成380% + 50% ATK的伤害，将其击退6格并击晕2.5秒。

Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, prioritizing the nearest ally in her row. After that ally deals ranged damage 3 times, they unleash a feather for an additional strike, dealing 120% + 20% ATK damage. This extra strike can trigger once every 0.5s.
If the ally granted Brightfeather is a ranged unit, their normal attack range is increased by 5 tiles. The ally loses Brightfeather if they are defeated.
Active. Aliceth shoots a charged arrow at an enemy, dealing 380% + 50% ATK damage, knocking them back 6 tiles, and stunning them for 2.5s.
主动释放时，伤害提升至420% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 420% + 50% ATK.
主动释放时，伤害提升至460% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 460% + 50% ATK.
主动释放时，伤害提升至500% + 50% ATK。
Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 500% + 50% ATK.
锁定最远的敌人，并使“光翼”权能的友军和自身优先攻击这名敌人。
Aliceth marks the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather will prioritize attacking the marked enemy.

战斗开始时，亚莉克希使用“辉煌圣瞳”锁定场上最远的敌人，使自身和“光翼”权能的友军优先对其进行攻击，并且对这名敌人造成的伤害额外提升35 + 5点穿透。
被动地，亚莉克希连续锁定同一名敌人超过6秒或释放终极技能后，“辉煌圣瞳”得到强化，使亚莉克希对这名锁定的敌人造成伤害时，若这名敌人的生命值低于300% + 30% ATK会立刻将其击败。当敌人被击败或无法选中时，将会更换锁定目标并重置“辉煌圣瞳”的状态。

When a battle starts, Aliceth places her Mark of Judgment on the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather both prioritize attacking the marked enemy, and their attacks against that enemy gain an extra 35 + 5 Penetration.
Passive. After Aliceth locks on the same enemy for 6s or casts her Ultimate, the Mark of Judgment is enhanced. The enhanced mark allows her to instantly defeat the marked enemy if her attack reduces the enemy's HP below 300% + 30% ATK. If the marked enemy is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth shifts the mark to a new enemy, resetting the mark's duration counter.
对这名敌人造成的伤害额外提升40 + 5点穿透。
Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 40 + 5.
对这名敌人造成的伤害额外提升45 + 5点穿透。
Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 45 + 5.
对这名敌人造成的伤害额外提升50 + 5点穿透。
Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 50 + 5.
战斗中额外提升攻击力，并在击败锁定的敌人后额外提升攻击力。
Aliceth increases her ATK in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgment is defeated, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain extra ATK.
战斗中，提升9%攻击力，“辉煌圣瞳”锁定的敌人首次被击败或无法选中后，亚莉克希和获得“光翼”权能的友军额外获得6%的攻击力。
Aliceth increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgment is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 6% ATK.
战斗中，提升13%攻击力，“辉煌圣瞳”锁定的敌人首次被击败或无法选中后，亚莉克希和获得“光翼”权能的友军额外获得8%的攻击力。
Aliceth increases her ATK by 13% during battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgment is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 8% ATK.
战斗中，提升16%攻击力，“辉煌圣瞳”锁定的敌人首次被击败或无法选中后，亚莉克希和获得“光翼”权能的友军额外获得10%的攻击力。

Aliceth increases her ATK by 16% during battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgment is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 10% ATK.
自身和获得“光翼”权能的友军能够免于首次被击败。
The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a fatal blow, Aliceth prevents their defeat.
自身和获得“光翼”权能的友军会在首次受到最后一击时，免疫这次伤害，进入1.5秒的无敌状态，并会回复30% HP，随后被带到4格内安全的位置。该效果无法移动处于霸体或稳定状态的友军。该效果每个英雄至多触发1次。

The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a fatal blow, Aliceth prevents their defeat. The affected hero instead becomes invincible for 1.5s and recovers 30% HP. Afterward, Aliceth or the ally is moved to a safe spot within 4 tiles. But allies who are unaffected or steadfast will not be moved. This skill can trigger once per hero.
回复生命值提升至35% HP。
回复生命值提升至40% HP。
“光翼”每发射4枚飞羽，便会引发1次光能爆炸，对1格范围的敌人造成330% ATK伤害，并施加致盲，持续3秒，期间敌人每秒失去40% ATK生命值。

For every 4 feathers unleashed by an ally with Brightfeather, a burst of light erupts, dealing 330% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and blinding them for 3s. Blinded enemies lose 40% ATK HP per second.
“光翼”每发射一定数量的飞羽，会使自身终极技能获得额外的射击次数。
Each time an ally with Brightfeather unleashes a set number of feathers, Aliceth's Ultimate is enhanced to fire additional volleys of arrows with each cast.
“光翼”每发射4枚飞羽，还会使本场战斗中亚莉克希后续释放“神弓箭雨”时会额外发射1波箭雨，通过这个方式至多增加6波箭雨。

For every 4 feathers unleashed by an ally with Brightfeather, Aliceth's Radiant Rain is enhanced to fire 1 extra arrow volley for the rest of the battle. Through this, she can fire up to 6 extra arrow volleys in total.
